project: awesome-sub-agents: a catalogue of 172 Autohand sub-agents, with per-category READMEs, a main README index and a generated registry.json

developers.name: helm-chart-reviewer
developers.description: Use when a task needs Helm chart review for values, templates, upgrades and rollback safety.

developers.name: pulumi-engineer
developers.description: Use when a task needs Pulumi programs planned, reviewed or changed with preview-first safety.

developers.name: zig-pro
developers.description: Use when a task needs idiomatic Zig, comptime design, allocator discipline or C interop.

developers.name: scala-engineer
developers.description: Use when a task needs Scala 3 code, effect systems, sbt builds or JVM interop.

developers.name: vector-search-engineer
developers.description: Use when a task needs embedding pipelines, vector index choice or retrieval quality tuning.

developers.name: prompt-injection-auditor
developers.description: Use when a task needs prompt-injection exposure reviewed across tools, retrieval and agent boundaries.

developers.name: eval-dataset-curator
developers.description: Use when a task needs eval datasets built, deduplicated, labelled or audited for leakage.

developers.name: changelog-writer
developers.description: Use when a task needs release notes or a changelog written from commits and merged changes.

developers.name: finops-analyst
developers.description: Use when a task needs cloud spend analysed, attributed or reduced without hurting reliability.

developers.name: graphql-schema-reviewer
developers.description: Use when a task needs a GraphQL schema reviewed for evolution, nullability and breaking changes.

developers.name: docker-expert
developers.description: Use when a task needs Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, image size or container runtime behaviour fixed.

developers.name: terraform-engineer
developers.description: Use when a task needs Terraform modules, plans or state changes made with drift and blast radius in view.

developers.name: api-designer
developers.description: Use when a task needs an API contract designed or evolved, with compatibility checked before code.

developers.name: docker-expert
developers.description: Use when a task needs container images built, slimmed, scanned or debugged at runtime.

developers.text: - Name the failure mode the agent exists to prevent in its first paragraph.
- Run `python3 scripts/generate_registry.py` after adding or renaming an agent, and commit `registry.json`.
The registry is generated. Do not edit `registry.json` by hand; run `python3 scripts/generate_registry.py`.
Agents are plain Markdown files, so they can also be copied by hand into any of the storage locations below.

developers.name: argocd-operator
developers.description: Use when a task needs Argo CD applications, sync policies or rollout health investigated.

developers.name: secrets-scanner
developers.description: Use when a task needs leaked credentials found in code, history or build output, and rotation planned.
